up: Retrieve IC50 activity data for target CHEMBL1936 (Mast/stem cell growth factor receptor Kit). Return DISTINCT rows containing: canonical SMILES, compound ChEMBL ID, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI (prefer pubmed_id if both exist, otherwise doi), assay description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Apply filters: target_type must be 'SINGLE PROTEIN', organism must be 'Homo sapiens', canonical_smiles must not be null, and at least one of pubmed_id or doi must be present. Ensure standard_units are 'nM' and standard_type is 'IC50'.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936'
  AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL)
